facts.value: The program focuses on the languages of the Caucasus (Georgian, Megrelian, Udi, etc.) and includes language comparison, language documentation, digital corpora of Caucasian languages, digital research methods, and the languages and cultures of the Caucasus.
facts.original_value: Sprachen des Kaukasus (Georgisch, Megrelisch, Udisch, ... ) > Sprachvergleich, Sprachdokumentation, Digitale Korpora der Kauk. Sprachen, Digitale Forschungsmethoden, Sprachen und Kulturen des Kaukasus

facts.value: The program includes an open study format, small courses, and summer schools in Georgia.
facts.original_value: freies Studium, kleine Kurse, Sommerschulen in Georgien
